If an obstacle is detected between the glass and the upper safety casing whilst the window is closing, it does not stop immediately or change direction.
To ensure that the windows close fully in doors without an upper frame, the electric windows have a system known as short drop. For more information on this subject, see [DF_7005M]
The change of direction if an obstacle is detected lasts for around 300 ms.
